label: License keys
description: Products with license keys turned on give each buyer a key. Your software can check keys with the license API at /functions/digital_downloads/license-api.

fields.label: Low stock alert for imported keys
fields.description: When a product has this many unsold imported keys left, store admins get an email to import more. Checkout stops selling a product when its imported keys run out. Doesn't apply to generated keys.
